summary: Verified production static-build fix for RealAICoach: build/ artifacts, static-serve simulation on port 9099, package.json build script, verify-package-json, preview backend/admin login, and 7-test import_bringup pytest suite. All checks passed; no regressions to Metro dev flow.

verification_details.build_log_tmp_yarn_build_fix_log: ends with '[assemble-static-build] done: build/ = client assets + 215 route HTML pages (+204 directory-index mirrors); root index.html OK' and 'BUILD_EXIT:0' after 364.05s

critical_code_review_comments: scripts/assemble-static-build.js correctly assembles dist/client + dist/server route HTML into build/ with directory-index mirrors + 200/404 fallbacks; fails loudly if dist/server/index.html missing — matches nginx directory-index resolution used in prod.
app.json web.output='server' intentionally preserved; assembler bridges the server-mode export output to a static-servable tree without needing a Node server.
No changes to Metro `start` flow — dev/preview experience unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end: static-servable build/ tree produced by scripts/assemble-static-build.js, all requested URLs (/, /pricing/, /features/, /auth/, JS bundle) serve correctly under plain-static simulation. Preview Metro flow and backend endpoints unaffected. Do NOT rebuild — takes ~6 min; proof in /tmp/yarn_build_fix.log.
rca_of_the_issue: app.json web.output='server' causes `expo export` to emit dist/server/ (per-route HTML) + dist/client/ (assets), a layout that requires a Node runtime. Previous `build` script copied dist verbatim so no root build/index.html existed, and the platform's production nginx (which serves build/ as static) fell back to the default nginx welcome page. Mitigation: new assemble-static-build.js merges dist/client + dist/server route HTMLs into build/, mirrors X.html to X/index.html for nginx directory-index resolution, and writes 200.html/404.html. Verified all target routes return 200 with RealAICoach content.
